title: Osseointegration of Superhydrophilic Implants Placed in Defect Grafted Bones. El
authors: Chaar E, Zhang L, Zhou Y, Sandgren R, Fricain JC, Dard M, Pippenger B, Catros S. Int J Oral Maxillofac Implants. 2019 March/April;34(2):443–450. doi: 10.11607/jomi.7172.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The authors concluded that the results suggest that implants with a superhydrophilic modSLA surface are more conducive to faster osseointegration even in conjunction with simultaneous bone grafting procedures” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
